_comment: Three lists. firstRun: shown on the first-run choice screen, where the user has no routine, no tasks and no UI to point at — only statements that are TRUE for a stranger. inApp: shown on every later boot and on the Welcome Screen, free to reference UI. useCases: the rotating "that's me" hook. Not routed through getLabel(): the pre-boot rotator runs before labels exist. NOTE: miniCycle.html's first-run controller carries its OWN copy of useCases as an inline ES5 array (it must paint before any fetch resolves) — keep the two in sync.
firstRun: Auto Cycle mode resets tasks automatically when all are completed
Manual Cycle mode lets you reset tasks at your own pace
To-Do mode removes completed tasks like a traditional checklist
Your progress is saved locally — no account needed
The app works offline once loaded — perfect for on-the-go
Unlock new themes by completing cycles — 5 themes to discover
inApp: Tap the ＋/－ button to add or remove task buttons
Use the 📁 folder button to switch between different routines
Tap the 🖌️ paintbrush icon to personalize colors and themes
Tap the 🌙 moon icon to switch to dark mode
Click your progress badge to see detailed completion stats
The help window explains your routine's current status and mode
Check your task history for your routine in the stats modal
Watch the logo — it animates when you complete tasks or reset a cycle
Different vocabulary themes change how the app describes your tasks
Want a walkthrough? Turn on Enable Tour Prompts in the menu under Help & Support
Drag tasks to reorder them by priority
Long-press a task to see quick options like edit and delete
Set up recurring tasks to auto-add them on a schedule
Export your routine as a .mcyc file to share with others
Use the 🧹 broom button to auto-clear specific tasks on reset or when clearing completed
